new_page.title: Vancouver Condos for Sale | Downtown to East Van
new_page.description: Search Vancouver condos for sale. See Downtown, Yaletown, Kitsilano and Mount Pleasant sold prices, strata fees by building and the apartment benchmark.

faq.q: How much is a condo in Vancouver?
faq.a: It varies by neighbourhood: $520,000 in Collingwood, $659,000 Downtown, $770,000 in the West End and $853,000 in Yaletown, over the year to October 22, 2026. The apartment benchmark was $751,400 West and $635,100 East in October 2026.

faq.q: Where do most Vancouver condos sell?
faq.a: Downtown (454 sales), Yaletown (320), the West End (314), Kitsilano (240) and Mount Pleasant East (236).

faq.q: What are strata fees in Vancouver?
faq.a: Median fees run from $410 in Collingwood to $918 in Coal Harbour. Yaletown is $644 and Downtown $523.

faq.q: Is Yaletown on the Canada Line?
faq.a: Yes, Yaletown-Roundhouse station. The Yaletown Historic Area (HA-3) also caps building height at 21.4 metres.
Over one year the apartment benchmark moved -3.8% in Vancouver West and -3.9% in Vancouver East, to $751,400 and $635,100 in October 2026.

faq.q: Does Vancouver have a tax on empty condos?
faq.a: Yes. The Empty Homes Tax is 3% of assessed value for a home that is not occupied or rented.

blocks.text: This search lists condos for sale in the city of Vancouver, from Coal Harbour and Yaletown to Collingwood and South Marine. Houses and townhomes have their own searches.

3,241 Vancouver condos closed in the year to October 22, 2026: 2,342 in Vancouver West and 899 in Vancouver East. Downtown led with 454 sales at a median of $659,000. The sold records report Vancouver by neighbourhood, so each neighbourhood has its own median.

Downtown peninsula neighbourhoods have the volume. Downtown had 454 sales, Yaletown 320 at $853,000, the West End 314 at $770,000, and Kitsilano 240 at $782,500. Coal Harbour is the premium end: 117 sales at $1,228,000 and a strata fee of $918 a month, the highest in the West table below.

blocks.text: East of Main Street prices fall quickly. Mount Pleasant (East) had 236 sales at $698,500, Collingwood 149 at $520,000 and South Marine 110 at $627,500. Collingwood’s median strata fee is $410 a month, well below Coal Harbour’s $918. South Marine is newer (median built 2018) at $822 a square foot.

blocks.text: Rules and risks that apply to Vancouver condos

Yaletown is on the Canada Line at Yaletown-Roundhouse station, and the Yaletown Historic Area (HA-3) caps building height at 21.4 metres. Parts of False Creek North are exposed to flooding from sea-level rise, so ask what the strata has planned.

Vancouver’s Empty Homes Tax is 3% of assessed value for a home that is neither occupied nor rented. The Tenant Relocation and Protection Policy applies citywide if a rented building is redeveloped. For the strata documents you should read before you buy, see the BC condo buying rules.
If you want a new building rather than a resale, the presale condos and townhomes page lists the Vancouver projects. The downtown condo search is a narrower view of the peninsula.
